name: Waves of Exhaustion

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: While active, Magic actions emit a 60-foot Cone. Creatures save Constitution or gain 1 Exhaustion, never increasing the target’s total Exhaustion above 4. All Exhaustion gained from this spell ends with it.
text: While active, Magic actions emit a 60-foot Cone. Creatures save Constitution or gain 1 Exhaustion, never increasing the target’s total Exhaustion above 4. All Exhaustion gained from this spell ends with it.

sustain.label: Waves of Exhaustion
sustain.help: Magic action: each failed save adds 1 Exhaustion, up to a total level of 4. These levels end with the spell.
